definition.section: What a capability is, and is not
rows: An ability the business possesses — a stable noun phrase, "Manage Delivery Exceptions"
A department . If renaming a team changes the map, you have mapped the org chart
A bundle of people, process, information and technology
A process . Processes are how and in what order; capabilities are what, and are order-independent
An application . If replacing a system changes the map, you have mapped the estate
Realised by one or more business functions
A broad area of the business — Supply Chain, Customer Service, Clinical Operations
A named ability within a domain — Manage Delivery Exceptions
The level at which investment is actually decided — Detect Delay, Assess Contractual Exposure
The stopping rule: decompose until further decomposition stops changing an investment decision, then stop
